description: This Java class 'LoggingHandler' extends Netty's ChannelDuplexHandler to provide detailed logging of network channel events, including connection states, data transmission, SSL handshake events, and exceptions. It includes custom byte buffer formatting for hex and ASCII representations.

classes.name: LoggingHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler that logs channel events, data transfer, SSL handshakes, and exceptions with detailed formatting, including hex and ASCII dump of ByteBuf contents.
